source_row.stem: A nurse teaches a client anger management techniques. An evidence-based strategy includes:
source_row.item_data_json: {"options":{"A":"Suppressing all outward expression of anger indefinitely, rather than acknowledging and working through the feeling","B":"Immediately confronting the source of the anger without pausing to first recognize or regulate the emotional response","C":"Recognizing early physical/emotional cues of anger and using techniques such as deep breathing or taking a brief timeout before reacting","D":"Avoiding any self-awareness of one's own emotional triggers, rather than learning to recognize them early"}}
source_row.rationale: Evidence-based anger management includes recognizing early physical or emotional cues of rising anger and using techniques such as deep breathing or a brief timeout to pause before reacting, supporting more controlled responses.
